key: A switch on the machine opens the case.
en: A switch on the machine opens the case.
ja: マシンのスイッチを押すと　ケースが　開く。

key: Press it?
en: Press it?
ja: 押しますか?

key: Who wouldn't?
en: Who wouldn't?
ja: 押さない人なんて　いる?

key: Better not...
en: Better not...
ja: やめておいたほうが……

key: We've been tremendously lucky so far.
en: We've been tremendously lucky so far.
ja: ここまで　私たちは　驚くほど　運が良かった。

key: If we can just secure a few more components, then we should be able to create a perfect match...
en: If we can just secure a few more components, then we should be able to create a perfect match...
ja: あと　いくつか　部品さえ　確保できれば　完璧な適合体を　作り出せる　はず……

key: Miss Nadira's behavior has always been peculiar, but admittedly, she is starting to concern me...
en: Miss Nadira's behavior has always been peculiar, but admittedly, she is starting to concern me...
ja: ナディラさんの言動は　昔から　どこか　変わっていたが　正直なところ　最近は　少し　心配に　なってきた……

key: Just what does this project mean to her?
en: Just what does this project mean to her?
ja: この計画は　彼女にとって　いったい　何を　意味するのだろう?

key: NADIRA: You're back! I missed you!
en: NADIRA: You're back! I missed you!
ja: ナディラ: 帰ってきたのね! 会いたかったわ!

key: Everything's finished now.
en: Everything's finished now.
ja: もう　すべて　終わったの。

key: He's inside.
en: He's inside.
ja: 彼は　中に　いるのよ。

key: And he's perfect.
en: And he's perfect.
ja: それで　彼は　完璧なの。

key: Do you want to meet him?
en: Do you want to meet him?
ja: 会いたい?

key: I can't wait.
en: I can't wait.
ja: 待ちきれないわ。

key: Come on~
en: Come on~
ja: さあ　こっちに～

key: NADIRA: He's so beautiful...
en: NADIRA: He's so beautiful...
ja: ナディラ: なんて　美しいのかしら……

key: We really did it... You and I.
en: We really did it... You and I.
ja: 本当に　やり遂げたのね……　あなたと　わたしで。

key: Everyone else disappeared...
en: Everyone else disappeared...
ja: 他のみんなは　みんな　いなくなってしまった……

key: But you're still here.
en: But you're still here.
ja: でも　あなたは　まだ　ここに　いる。

key: And now we have this perfect baby to call our own.
en: And now we have this perfect baby to call our own.
ja: それで　今　わたしたちには　この完璧な赤ちゃんが　いるの。

key: I think you'll make a wonderful parent, \PN.
en: I think you'll make a wonderful parent, \PN.
ja: あなたは　きっと　すばらしい親に　なるわ\PN。

key: I think you'll make a wonderful mother, \PN.
en: I think you'll make a wonderful mother, \PN.
ja: あなたは　きっと　すばらしい母親に　なるわ\PN。

key: I think you'll make a wonderful father, \PN.
en: I think you'll make a wonderful father, \PN.
ja: あなたは　きっと　すばらしい父親に　なるわ\PN。

key: Let's take good care of him togeth--
en: Let's take good care of him togeth--
ja: 一緒に　大切に　育てましょう――

key: NADIRA: O-oh--
en: NADIRA: O-oh--
ja: ナディラ: あ　あら――

key: S-so... you still had the m-memories from those P-Pokémon after all...
en: S-so... you still had the m-memories from those P-Pokémon after all...
ja: や　やっぱり……　あの　ポケモンたちの　記憶を　まだ　持っていたのね……

key: I see... b-but what I did t-to them was--
en: I see... b-but what I did t-to them was--
ja: そう……　で　でも　わたしが　あの子たちに　したことは――

key: I only wanted t-to love you...
en: I only wanted t-to love you...
ja: ただ……　あなたを　愛したかっただけ……
わたし――

key: Never c-could have a ch-child of my own, so--
en: Never c-could have a ch-child of my own, so--
ja: 自分の子どもを　持つことなんて　絶対に　できなかったから――
\PN……

key: P-please... t-take good c-care...
en: P-please... t-take good c-care...
ja: お　お願い……　ちゃんと　大事に　して……

key: The Pokémon attacked!
en: The Pokémon attacked!
ja: ポケモンが　おそいかかってきた!

key: Type:Null ran away!
en: Type:Null ran away!
ja: タイプ:ヌルは　逃げていった!

key: With the Aether Foundation's data, we should be able to do this, but I can't help but feel nervous.
en: With the Aether Foundation's data, we should be able to do this, but I can't help but feel nervous.
ja: エーテル財団のデータが　あれば　これは　可能なはずだが　どうしても　不安を　感じてしまう。

key: One miscalculation could cost not only the whole project, but all of our lives too.
en: One miscalculation could cost not only the whole project, but all of our lives too.
ja: ひとつの計算ミスが　計画全体だけでなく　私たち全員の命さえも　奪いかねない。

key: I'd better double-check our measurements again...
en: I'd better double-check our measurements again...
ja: もう一度　測定値を　確認しておいたほうがいいな……

key: Even though I signed onto this project, I can't help but question the ethics of it.
en: Even though I signed onto this project, I can't help but question the ethics of it.
ja: この計画に　参加すると　決めたものの　その倫理観については　どうしても　疑問を　感じてしまう。

key: Especially once we get our live material in, I wonder...
en: Especially once we get our live material in, I wonder...
ja: 特に　生体の材料が　届いたら　どうなるのか……

key: ???: Don't worry, my darling, I won't leave you in this state for long.
en: ???: Don't worry, my darling, I won't leave you in this state for long.
ja: ???: 心配しないで　愛しい人　この状態のまま　長くは　しておかないから。

key: Oh.
en: Oh.
ja: あら。

key: Street trash blew in.
en: Street trash blew in.
ja: 通りのゴミが　迷いこんできたわ。

key: I'll have to ask you to leave.
en: I'll have to ask you to leave.
ja: 出て行ってもらわないと。

key: Pity.
en: Pity.
ja: ナディラ: 残念ね。

key: NADIRA: Even though you won, if you're here to steal our research, I won't allow it.
en: NADIRA: Even though you won, if you're here to steal our research, I won't allow it.
ja: ナディラ: 勝ったとはいえ　わたしたちの研究を　盗みに来たのなら　それは　許さないわ。

key: I've worked too hard to bring this to life to let it go again...
en: I've worked too hard to bring this to life to let it go again...
ja: これに　命を　吹きこむために　あまりにも　苦労してきたのよ　二度と　手放したりは　しない……

key: Look at him.
en: Look at him.
ja: 見て　この子を。

key: NADIRA: Isn't he beautiful?
en: NADIRA: Isn't he beautiful?
ja: ナディラ: 美しいでしょう?

key: It's taken us months to get this far, and even now all we have is the main body, control system and framework.
en: It's taken us months to get this far, and even now all we have is the main body, control system and framework.
ja: ここまで来るのに　何か月も　かかったのよ　それでも　今あるのは　本体と　制御システムと　骨組みだけ。

key: Do you know what it is?
en: Do you know what it is?
ja: これが　何か　わかる?

key: NADIRA: So you do understand.
en: NADIRA: So you do understand.
ja: ナディラ: やっぱり　わかるのね。

key: And you know because you came here to take it, right?
en: And you know because you came here to take it, right?
ja: それで　それを　奪いに来たから　わかるんでしょう?

key: But it's no use like it is now.
en: But it's no use like it is now.
ja: でも　今の状態じゃ　何の役にも　立たないの。

key: In fact, perhaps you could be a blessing for us.
en: In fact, perhaps you could be a blessing for us.
ja: むしろ　あなたは　わたしたちにとって　恵みに　なるかもしれないわ。

key: NADIRA: Then, could it be that you're not here to steal it after all?
en: NADIRA: Then, could it be that you're not here to steal it after all?
ja: ナディラ: それじゃ　もしかして　盗みに来たわけじゃ　なかったの?

key: Perhaps you could be a blessing for us.
en: Perhaps you could be a blessing for us.
ja: あなたは　わたしたちにとって　恵みに　なるかもしれない。

key: Of course, he's still not complete! There's much more we have to do to bring him to life!
en: Of course, he's still not complete! There's much more we have to do to bring him to life!
ja: もちろん　彼は　まだ　完成していないのよ! 命を　吹きこむには　まだまだ　することが　あるの!

key: You see, we've had some setbacks in development... and as a result our funding has really run dry.
en: You see, we've had some setbacks in development...  and as a result our funding has really run dry.
ja: 実は　開発に　いくつか　つまずきがあって……　その結果　資金が　すっかり　底を　ついてしまって。

key: I'll do anything I can to finish him, but if we can't get the right parts, then we're at an impasse.
en: I'll do anything I can to finish him, but if we can't get the right parts, then we're at an impasse.
ja: 彼を　完成させるためなら　何だって　するけど　正しい部品が　手に入らなければ　行き詰まってしまう。

key: All we need now is the organic components that bring him to life.
en: All we need now is the organic components that bring him to life.
ja: 今　必要なのは　彼に　命を　吹きこむための　有機部品だけ。

key: Say, you're clearly a competent trainer.
en: Say, you're clearly a competent trainer.
ja: ねえ　あなたって　明らかに　優秀なトレーナーよね。

key: Would you be willing to help us finish my baby?
en: Would you be willing to help us finish my baby?
ja: わたしの赤ちゃんを　完成させるのを　手伝ってくれないかしら?

key: NADIRA: Ah, lucky~
en: NADIRA: Ah, lucky~
ja: ナディラ: ああ　ラッキー～

key: I knew you'd understand.
en: I knew you'd understand.
ja: わかってくれるって　思ってた。

key: Very well. I think the tasks I have for you will be perfectly in line with your skillset.
en: Very well. I think the tasks I have for you will be perfectly in line with your skillset.
ja: それじゃ。あなたに　頼みたいことは　あなたの能力に　ぴったり　だと思うわ。

key: Firstly, I'd like you to find a Carvanha and give it to me. Any will do.
en: Firstly, I'd like you to find a Carvanha and give it to me. Any will do.
ja: まず　キバニアを　見つけて　わたしに　渡してほしいの。どれでも　いいから。

key: I'll take it from there.
en: I'll take it from there.
ja: あとは　わたしが　引き受けるわ。

key: NADIRA: Truly a pity.
en: NADIRA: Truly a pity.
ja: ナディラ: 本当に　残念。

key: But that's okay. There's no need for outsiders to get involved.
en: But that's okay. There's no need for outsiders to get involved.
ja: でも　いいの。部外者が　関わる必要なんて　ないもの。

key: I'll take care of him myself...
en: I'll take care of him myself...
ja: 彼のことは　わたし自身で　面倒　見るから……

key: NADIRA: You're still here?
en: NADIRA: You're still here?
ja: ナディラ: まだ　いたの?

key: Could it be that you've reconsidered my request?
en: Could it be that you've reconsidered my request?
ja: もしかして　わたしのお願い　考え直してくれた?

key: NADIRA: Nobody really understands after all.
en: NADIRA: Nobody really understands after all.
ja: ナディラ: やっぱり　誰も　本当には　わかってくれないのね。

key: That's okay... I'm the only one he needs.
en: That's okay... I'm the only one he needs.
ja: それでいいの……　彼に　必要なのは　わたしだけだから。

key: NADIRA: Aha, did you already find Carvanha for me?
en: NADIRA: Aha, did you already find Carvanha for me?
ja: ナディラ: あら　もう　キバニア　見つけてくれたの?

key: NADIRA: Any Carvanha will be just fine-- so long as it's healthy of course.
en: NADIRA: Any Carvanha will be just fine-- so long as it's healthy of course.
ja: ナディラ: キバニアなら　何でもいいのよ――　もちろん　健康であればね。

key: Nothing but the best for my darling.
en: Nothing but the best for my darling.
ja: わたしの愛しい子には　最高のものしか　あげたくないの。

key: You understand, right?
en: You understand, right?
ja: わかるでしょう?

key: NADIRA: Ahh~ How perfect!
en: NADIRA: Ahh~ How perfect!
ja: ナディラ: ああ～　なんて　完璧なの!

key: I can feel him coming to life already...
en: I can feel him coming to life already...
ja: もう　彼が　命を　持ち始めてるのを　感じるわ……

key: I'll handle this from here, but there's another Pokémon we'll need.
en: I'll handle this from here, but there's another Pokémon we'll need.
ja: ここからは　わたしが　やるけど　もう一体　必要なポケモンが　いるの。

key: Unfezant, this time. Either gender is okay.
en: Unfezant, this time. Either gender is okay.
ja: 今度は　ケンホロウよ。性別は　どちらでも　いいわ。

key: I know you'll do great!
en: I know you'll do great!
ja: あなたなら　きっと　うまく　やってくれるはず!

key: NADIRA: Ohh, you're back. Did you get me an Unfezant?
en: NADIRA: Ohh, you're back. Did you get me an Unfezant?
ja: ナディラ: あら　帰ってきたのね。ケンホロウ　もらえた?

key: NADIRA: I'm sure you're working hard for me, so come back when you're ready to give it to me.
en: NADIRA: I'm sure you're working hard for me, so come back when you're ready to give it to me.
ja: ナディラ: きっと　わたしのために　がんばってくれてるのよね　用意できたら　また　来て。

key: Gender doesn't matter, of course.
en: Gender doesn't matter, of course.
ja: もちろん　性別は　関係ないわ。

key: After all, we won't be using most of it...
en: After all, we won't be using most of it...
ja: どのみち　ほとんどは　使わないんだから……

key: NADIRA: Oh, what a gorgeous Pokémon this is!
en: NADIRA: Oh, what a gorgeous Pokémon this is!
ja: ナディラ: まあ　なんて　見事なポケモンなのかしら!

key: And how even more gorgeous it'll become!
en: And how even more gorgeous it'll become!
ja: それに　これから　もっと　見事に　なるのよ!

key: You are a treasure, \PN.
en: You are a treasure, \PN.
ja: あなたは　宝物ね\PN。

key: There's just one more thing I need, okay?
en: There's just one more thing I need, okay?
ja: あと　ひとつだけ　必要なものが　あるの　いい?

key: This time, we need a Luxray.
en: This time, we need a Luxray.
ja: 今度は　レントラーが　必要なの。

key: Come back to me with it soon, okay?
en: Come back to me with it soon, okay?
ja: すぐに　持ってきてね　いい?

key: NADIRA: Welcome home! Did you bring Luxray?
en: NADIRA: Welcome home! Did you bring Luxray?
ja: ナディラ: おかえりなさい! レントラー　持ってきてくれた?

key: NADIRA: Your company is always a pleasure, but we do have work to do too.
en: NADIRA: Your company is always a pleasure, but we do have work to do too.
ja: ナディラ: あなたと　一緒にいるのは　いつも　楽しいけれど　やるべきことも　あるのよ。

key: We're so close!
en: We're so close!
ja: もうすぐなの!

key: Soon, I'll be able to take care of everything...
en: Soon, I'll be able to take care of everything...
ja: もうすぐ　すべてを　わたしの手で　やり遂げられるわ……

key: NADIRA: Ohh, I'm getting shivers from all the excitement...
en: NADIRA: Ohh, I'm getting shivers from all the excitement...
ja: ナディラ: ああ　興奮で　ぞくぞくしてきたわ……

key: I'll get right to work, okay~?
en: I'll get right to work, okay~?
ja: さっそく　取りかかるわね～?

key: I'll need time, but if you come back a bit later, then our precious will surely be ready.
en: I'll need time, but if you come back a bit later, then our precious will surely be ready.
ja: 時間は　かかるけど　少し　あとで　戻ってきてくれれば　わたしたちの大切な子が　きっと　準備できてるはず。

key: NADIRA: This is so much less painful than what most women have to deal with...
en: NADIRA: This is so much less painful than what most women have to deal with...
ja: ナディラ: これって　たいていの女性が　経験することより　ずっと　痛みが　少ないのよね……

key: Maybe I'm lucky after all~
en: Maybe I'm lucky after all~
ja: やっぱり　わたし　ラッキーなのかも～

key: But he's not ready yet. There's much more to do, so come back later, okay?
en: But he's not ready yet. There's much more to do, so come back later, okay?
ja: でも　彼は　まだ　準備できてないの。まだまだ　やることが　あるから　あとで　また　来て　いい?

key: I'll be waiting for you!
en: I'll be waiting for you!
ja: 待ってるわね!

key: A note in the book reads...
en: A note in the book reads...
ja: 本には　こう　メモが　書かれている……

key: "Successfully calibrated Multi-Attack to 120 BP per future project specifications..."
en: "Successfully calibrated Multi-Attack to 120 BP per future project specifications..."
ja: 「マルチアタックを　今後の計画仕様どおり　威力120に　調整することに　成功……」

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
